fieldValues.title: Reader in A shared practice that refines itself
fieldValues.summary: A member, trustee, crew member or client who reads a document an AI made from sources they did not see, and must decide whether to rely on it.
goals: rely on it without redoing the work
check any point that matters to them
follow a matter across documents over time
jobs: open a point down to the words or records it rests on
see what came from the source and what was added as context
follow a subject back through earlier documents
fieldValues.needs: A plain top layer; a short, fixed path from any statement to its source; context kept visibly apart from what the source said; nothing presented as agreed that was not.
